primary_secondary.note: Replication of a controlled experiment (new data).

study_type.claude: Experiment (external replication of a controlled experiment)

research_method.claude: External/differentiated replication of a controlled experiment; 2x2 factorial between-subjects (Approach TDD vs. YW; Object BSK vs. MRA); SAM plus liking; STR; ANOVA-Type Statistic and Cliff's delta
research_method.nlm: Replicated controlled experiment; 2x2 factorial design; SAM 9-point scales plus liking; STR; ANOVA Type Statistic; Cliff's delta reported for the baseline
research_method.value: Replicated controlled experiment; 2x2 factorial between-subjects design (Approach: TDD vs. Your Way; Object: Bowling Score Keeper vs. Mars Rover API), single 3-hour Java/JUnit session; affective reactions via Self-Assessment Manikin plus liking (12 DVs) and development performance (STR); ANOVA-Type Statistic, Cliff's delta; compared with the baseline experiment

context.claude: Academic; 59 second-year CS undergraduates in the SE course at the University of Bari (baseline: 29 third-year, University of Basilicata)
context.nlm: Academic; 59 second-year CS undergraduates (replication), 29 third-year (baseline); University of Bari and University of Basilicata, Italy
context.value: academic; SE course at the University of Bari (Italy), lab session; 59 second-year CS undergraduates (baseline: 29 third-year undergraduates, University of Basilicata)

cat_productivity.note: STR: user stories implemented within a fixed 3-hour window, normalized to [0, 100].

cat_quality.note: Acceptance test suites only verify which user stories count as implemented.

cat_satisfaction.note: Affective reactions (pleasure, arousal, dominance, liking) are the dependent variables.

cat_delivery.note: NotebookLM labels STR 'Productivity / Delivery'; it is stories done in fixed time (Productivity).

cat_devex.note: NotebookLM labels affective DVs 'DevEx / Satisfaction' but states DevEx is not referenced.

cat_agile.note: TDD (an XP practice) is the treatment, not a measured process metric; borderline if the author codes the agile practice itself.

cat_survey.note: Self-Assessment Manikin and liking rating scales (self-report).

evidence.quote: To validate the results of the experiment by Romano et al. [21] (also called baseline experiment from here on), we conducted a replicated experiment with 59 novice developers.
The design of the baseline experiment was 2 * 2 factorial [27]. Such a kind of between-subjects design has two factors (i.e., two IVs) having two levels each.
by using ANOVA Type Statistic (ATS) [4], a nonparametric version of ANOVA recommended in the HCI research field to analyze rating-scale data in factorial designs
II-year undergraduates in CS taking the SE course at the University of Bari Participant number 29 59
To measure the affective reactions of developers, we used the Self-Assessment Manikin instrument complemented with a liking dimension.
count the number of user stories each participant implemented within the fixed time frame (i.e., three hours)
We used ATS to analyze STR because the normality assumption of ANOVA was not met (Shapiro-Wilk normality test p-value = 0.001).
